params.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit IMAGE1 as one single production sprite, preserving its canvas and character size. IMAGE1 is the ONLY identity/composition/upper-body reference. IMAGE2 bamboo girl is shoe-axis/perspective reference only, do not copy her character, limbs, props or phase. IMAGE3 is approved painted style.
Change ONLY the two legs from hip joints downward and the immediately overlapping skirt edge necessary for anatomy. Keep head, ears, neck, shoulders, torso, waist bow, both arms, fox, crystal, their exact scales and positions unchanged. No zoom, no larger head, no longer torso, no recentering.
Three-quarter rear NORTHEAST view, travelling toward upper-right. A foot IN FRONT of hip goes upper-right/deeper; a foot BEHIND hip goes lower-left/closer. Foot longitudinal axes remain upper-right/lower-left, knee/ankle aligned; no outward splay. Anatomical left is the farther leg, anatomical right nearer.
P4 rear push-off position, variant 1/2. The SAME LEFT leg extends farther BEHIND the hip along travel axis. The FRONT BALL/TOES of this boot still press on virtual ground while its heel rises a little, creating a clear final push-off contact. The RIGHT knee is forward, its boot lifted ready for the next landing. No flight yet; one real toe-pad contact, no full flat sole floating toward the viewer. This is the earlier pose in the two-frame spatial contact zone.
Exactly two arms and two legs. LEFT arm holds one white fox. RIGHT connected shoulder/elbow/wrist/palm holds one blue snowflake crystal. Same short white bob, furry ears, left hair ornament, white-lilac short fur robe, rear purple bow; no girl tail, no back fox-face belt buckle. Ground plane is invisible: no floor, shadow, background or guide marks. All boots inside the existing full square canvas with margin. Transparent RGBA, sharp detailed painted sprite, no text, no motion trails, no copies.

hint: Returned host path recorded in conversation before environment reload.
